verdict.a_single_large_eval_wedges_queue: NOT A DRIVER DEFECT, NOT A GPU WEDGE. The GPU completed every job in every run (queue syncobj advanced in lockstep with submissions, no dmesg GPU fault/timeout). The reported wedge is the 2026-09-04 mlx-omarchy counter-only watchdog firing on one legitimately long submission (~28 s lm_head matmul at 2048 tokens); the 'last observed=0, target=1' semaphore was the eval's Event timeline semaphore created just before that submission, not the device completion timeline. The current wheel (f5ba1c8, event-based progress d052b92a) runs the same eval in 12 s with no watchdog trip, but only when the Vulkan heap budget is raised: its 257-node batches hold 8.11 GB against Honeykrisp's default 7.56 GiB heap (heap_memory_percent 50% of RAM) and fail with VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY on both stock and fork drivers.
verdict.b_test_sdpa_sigbus: NOT A DRIVER DEFECT, NO DEVICE-SIDE WRITER. Host-side use-after-free in mlx-omarchy: VulkanAllocator::free released a VulkanBuffer whose raw pointer was still in CommandEncoder::batch_buffers_ (stale drained stamp 0x58 not re-stamped kPendingCompletion because note_batch_buffer only stamped when completion == 0); the next submit() wrote the new completion value (0x5a = 90) through the dangling pointer into a glibc-heap chunk that by then held an array::Data control block (the deleter std::function's _M_manager), and the array destructor jumped to pc=0x5a. Fixed in mlx-omarchy 9cef4d3d (note_batch_buffer stamps unconditionally), which is absent from the cited wheel 70183d3 and present in f5ba1c8; test_sdpa passes on stock Honeykrisp with f5ba1c8.
verdict.gelu_approx_1e13: not reproducible on Honeykrisp: test_nn.py -k gelu passes (1 passed) with f5ba1c8 on stock driver; llvmpipe-only observation, not driver-side here.
verdict.sdpa_vector_decomposition: not reproducible on Honeykrisp: test_fast_sdpa.py::TestFastSDPA::test_sdpa_vector passes (1 passed), test_sdpa_fully_masked passes (1 passed) with f5ba1c8 on stock driver.
verdict.new_finding_sdpa_full_head_dim_256: mlx-omarchy kernel bug, not driver: 14 subtests (mask='causal', kL >= 2048, float32 and bfloat16) fail identically on stock, honeykrisp-coopmat, hk/byte-extract, hk/precise-math AND llvmpipe (lvp_icd.aarch64.json, 14 failed / 1 passed in 193.99 s).

evidence_b.mechanism_in_mlx_source: overlay/mlx/backend/omarchy/allocator.h note_batch_buffer(): at 111dbcd and 70183d3 it reads 'if (buf && buf->completion == 0) buf->completion = kPendingCompletion;' - a buffer re-recorded into the open batch while carrying a stale drained stamp (0x58) keeps that stamp, so allocator.cpp free() (completion+1 > drained_value() false) sets completion=0 and destroys it although encoder.cpp submit()'s 'for (auto* buf : batch_buffers_) buf->completion = completion_value;' will still dereference it. 9cef4d3d (2026-09-06 02:18) makes the stamp unconditional; 70183d3 (2026-09-06 01:14) predates it.
